title: Newspaper clipping A Foreign Baby Found

page_data.en:
2852.

A FOREIGN baby, about three
years old and unable to speak, was
found by officers of the Greater
Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety
in Chapei, near Fearon Road, on
Sunday. The nationality of the child
is unknown, but it is a blonde and
has a small bald spot on the back
of its head, just above the neck and,
at the time it was found, was wear-
ing a grey jumper. Those interest-
ed should apply to the Bureau of
Public Safety in Chung Hua Road.
page_data.zh:
2852.

周日，上海公共租界工部局警务处警员在闸北斐伦路（Fearon Road）附近发现一名约三岁、尚不能言语的外籍幼儿。该儿童国籍不明，金发，后脑勺近颈处有一小块秃斑，被发现时身穿灰色套头衫。有意者请至中华路公共安全局接洽。
